# Through_Silicon_Via

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-24

## Definition
A vertical electrical interconnect etched through silicon to route power, ground, or signals between stacked dies or wafer faces. It is critical for the packaging and power-delivery topology of wafer-scale and in-network neuromorphic hardware.
